lead.headline: Tennessee State came within five at Tennessee
lead.deck: The Tigers lost 83-78 to the Volunteers on Friday. UT Martin rates highest in the league.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Ohio Valley Conference, nine schools from Macomb and Edwardsville down to Cape Girardeau, Martin and Nashville. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Tennessee State (149th) lost 83-78 at Tennessee on Friday, after scoring 127 and 123 points in two home wins.
UT Martin rates highest in the league at 141st. The Skyhawks lost 100-98 in overtime at Tulane and 75-74 at IU Indianapolis, then won 82-65 at Arkansas State.
Southeast Missouri opened with an 86-79 win over Lipscomb.
Morehead State beat IU Indianapolis 79-75 on Saturday.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **4.** OVC losses by one or two points: UT Martin at Tulane and at IU Indianapolis, SIUE at Lipscomb and Southern Indiana at Evansville.
**127.** Tennessee State's points against East West, the league's high.
**2.** OVC teams in our national top 150, UT Martin and Tennessee State.

notes.headline: Southern Indiana's near miss
notes.body: The Screaming Eagles lost 78-76 in overtime at Evansville.

notes.headline: Eastern Illinois on the road
notes.body: The Panthers opened at Indiana, Iowa and Notre Dame before their first home win.

notes.headline: Lindenwood's week
notes.body: The Lions lost at Nebraska and at Omaha after two home wins.

notes.headline: One bid
notes.body: The OVC tournament in March decides the league's NCAA bid.
